randomness: System CSPRNG through counted SecureRandom.read; fixed random sources occur only in separately identified tests
measurement_limitations: Host memory is not an allocation limit or measured process RSS.
Runs share a development machine with other work; elapsed times are observations, not isolated benchmarks.
Each new cryptographic address in the recorded lifetime is attempted once; interrupted historical attempts are separately retained.
No constant-time or side-channel claim is made.
